scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0087; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: It is far away and The bus stop is far away are natural A1 distance statements.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently preserves the distance meaning of away.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One bounded lexical target is repeated in two concrete locations.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast distance and recent unrelated language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Classmates plausibly compare the distance of school and a bus stop.

difficultyFit.evidence: Short familiar be-sentences keep difficulty at A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Recognition, guided production, transfer and hidden retrieval vary the demand.

transferQuality.evidence: The target moves from a pronoun subject to a named location.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scene and tasks align on distance with away.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded distance sense is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this stage.
resolvedFindings: Persian meaning and orthography are coherent.
Character and learner-role rotation are maintained.
